title: Agent Workbench

runtimeEngine.label: Runtime engine
runtimeEngine.hint: This engine executes the Agent. Save to use it for new conversations; existing conversations keep their engine. In chat, just choose an Agent.
runtimeEngine.unavailable: The catalog or selected build is unavailable. Retry or choose another engine for this Agent. No automatic fallback is used.
runtimeEngine.codingLimit: This Coding build provides file/Git tools, conversation-isolated snapshots, commands/interactive processes, MCP and plugin tools, and packaged Skills, subject to the Agent's saved enabled capabilities, bound resources and platform permissions. New conversations freeze that configuration; capabilities are not activated on demand. Instructions added during execution are handled at execution boundaries. Images require an enabled vision capability and a compatible model. Git push is limited to explicitly authorized pushes to configured local/file remotes; SSH/HTTPS credentials, force push and ref deletion are unavailable. These capabilities have not all completed end-to-end validation.

page.title: Agent page
page.hint: The built-in page is the supported default. Plugin pages are experimental and require host opt-in; attachments, permission interactions and recovery are not fully supported. Page preferences are saved separately from the Agent configuration.
page.openHint: Open an empty session using the saved Agent configuration, then compose your first message in its page. No message is sent by this action. To choose a model, workspace or other resources first, use Start conversation below.
page.saveAgentFirst: Save or discard Agent changes before opening its page.
page.savePageFirst: Save the page choice before opening it, or select the currently saved default.
page.openFailed: Opening the session was not confirmed. Check conversation history before creating another; no creation or message is retried automatically. If resources or a model are required, use Start conversation below.

view.title: Session view (experimental)
view.remember: Set selected view as Agent default
view.defaultConsent: Saving a default for {{name}} allows this exact plugin release to read, send and cancel in its sessions whenever you open their pages. This does not grant access in the background or change running sessions. Upgrades require a new choice. Using a view without saving affects this page only.
view.defaultFailed: The saved page choice could not be read. The built-in view remains available; refresh before saving a default.
view.defaultSaveFailed: Saving the page default was not confirmed. Refresh to check the saved choice before trying again; no save or turn is retried automatically.
view.defaultUnavailable: The saved exact plugin release is unavailable or experimental plugin pages are disabled on this host. Its choice is retained; use the built-in view or explicitly select an available release.
view.templateFailed: Draft creation was not confirmed. Check drafts in the plugin library before trying again. No view was selected or Session access granted.
view.consent: Using a plugin view grants this exact release access to read this session, send messages and cancel turns. Changing views does not restart or cancel a turn.
view.failed: The selected view could not open. Retry or explicitly return to the built-in view.
view.catalogFailed: Plugin views could not be refreshed. You can still use the built-in view.
view.changed: The selected release is no longer available. Refresh and review a current view, or return to the built-in view.
view.closeFailed: The old view was disconnected locally, but server revocation could not be confirmed. Retry closing the plugin from its library before relying on revocation.

middlewareOrder.title: Model request middleware order
middlewareOrder.hint: Selected before_model middleware runs in this order. Unlisted middleware follows in ID order; each receives the previous result. This does not change permissions or Context order. Save to apply to new sessions; existing sessions keep their frozen order.
middlewareOrder.empty: Add request middleware capabilities to configure their order.
middlewareOrder.missing: Middleware is unavailable or no longer selected. Restore it or reset the order.

contextOrder.title: Context contribution order
contextOrder.hint: Contributors run in this order within their declared phase (startup or before inference). Unlisted contributors follow in ID order. This does not reorder the full prompt pipeline or change permissions. Save to apply to a new session.
contextOrder.empty: Add Context capabilities to configure their order.
contextOrder.missing: Unavailable or no longer selected. Restore the contribution or reset the order.

subtitle: Configure your Agents around the work you want to do.

providers.defaultsHint: Configured by the installation owner. New or re-saved Agents inherit these defaults unless overridden. Saved versions and existing sessions remain unchanged. Save each choice separately.
providers.defaultsMissingHint: The previous default or its contract is unavailable. Its selection is retained. Restore the plugin or explicitly choose another implementation.
providers.defaultsLoadError: Cannot read defaults. Check that you are the installation owner, then reload.
providers.defaultsSaveError: Save failed: the implementation may be unavailable or another operation changed the default. Reload and confirm your choice.
providers.title: Component implementations
providers.hint: Choose implementations for the selected capabilities. Saving checks compatibility and dependencies; execution still requires authorization. Existing sessions keep their frozen implementation. Choosing a component does not add its internal tools to the Agent.
providers.empty: Selected capabilities do not expose replaceable components. Add a capability with a component contract first.
providers.missingHint: The selected implementation or its contract is no longer in the catalog. Your choice has been kept. Choose another implementation or explicitly use the configured default.

freshStart.title: Fresh v4 workspace
freshStart.body: This generation starts with {{count}} official templates and an empty personal library. Previous settings are not imported; fork a template or create a new Agent here.
